article.story: OMAHA, Neb. -- — Wes Enis scored 25 points and Creighton beat Kansas City 76-61 on Monday night to begin the season. Enis shot 7 for 18 (5 for 13 from 3-point range) and 6 of 8 from the free-throw line for the Bluejays. B.J. Davis added 13 points and four steals. Jaylen Smith led the way for the Roos with 15 points and five assists. Sebastian Hartmann added eight points, seven rebounds, four assists and two steals. Enis scored 17 points after halftime to help the Bluejays overcome a 39-33 halftime deficit. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
